question: India is bordered by Myanmar in the ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**east**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• There are namely four northeastern states with whom India shares borders with Myanmar which are Arunachal Pradesh, Nagaland, Manipur, and Mizoram.
 
• India shares a 1643 km long border with Myanmar in four north-eastern states namely, Arunachal (520 km), Nagaland (215 km), Manipur (398 km) and Mizoram (510 km) with Myanmar's Sagaing Region and Chin State.
